gbm_population_evidence.quote: Falls into one of the following diagnosis categories, including but not limited to: * Atypical teratoid rhabdoid tumor * Glioblastoma multiforme

gbm_population_flag.reason: GBM is one of many named paediatric cancers in a communication study; could be judged not_glioblastoma. Child-only, would fail age screening anyway.

candidate_evidence.quote: The intervention is a series of 3 guided discussions (using visual aids) between the child's primary oncology physician/nurse team and the child's parent(s)

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Child newly diagnosed, i.e., within 16 weeks (112 days) from time of diagnosis of cancer
Child with relapsed cancer, defined as within 16 weeks (112 days) of first-time relapse

coder_notes: Behavioural communication intervention in children with cancer; no drugs. CHILD-only.
